AI-DRIVEN KNOWLEDGE DISCOVERY

AIKDAP

Knowledge discovery and analysis, grounded in your own documents.

Upload what you already have. AIKDAP reads it, retrieves against it, reranks what it finds, and answers only from evidence it can show you.

SCROLL
02
THE PROBLEM
Collecting information was never the hard part.
Most organisations already hold far more material than anyone can read. The difficulty is not storage or search. It is knowing what your own documents actually say — and being able to show why you believe it.

Search finds documents.

You still have to read them.

Assistants generate text.

Fluent, confident, and accountable to nothing you own.

Neither shows its evidence.

So neither can be checked, and neither can be trusted with a decision.

03
WHAT AIKDAP DOES
Document preparation and research follow different paths.
Simplified conceptual overview — not live progress or measured production metrics. Ingestion prepares documents; query-time orchestration selects work and records the stages, optional steps and fallbacks that actually ran.
Document ingestion
Collect
01

Documents are uploaded into a project. Owner and project scope determine access before document processing begins.

Extract and chunk
02

Text and passage positions are stored. Deterministic document processing can finish before optional model work.

Embed
03

Passage embedding is attempted before AI understanding is queued. Embedding has its own status; a failed attempt does not discard extracted text.

Research query
Plan and route
01

The question determines which retrieval agents are selected. Some requests proceed directly to context building.

Retrieve
02

When selected, project-document or web retrieval supplies candidate evidence. Document retrieval requires ready embeddings; it does not wait for an AI document profile.

Assess evidence
03

A configured reranker can score candidates against the question. If scores are unavailable, retrieval ordering is retained and relevance thresholding is reported as not applied.

Synthesize
04

The answer records its evidence outcome. Insufficient evidence may trigger one web fallback, an explicitly labelled general-knowledge answer, or an insufficient-evidence response. Citation and visualization verification are separate checks.

AI understanding is a separate, optional background task after embedding is attempted. It is not a prerequisite for retrieval. The run timeline shows actual execution, including skipped or failed work.

04
AI UNDERSTANDING
Optional document profiles add context in the background.
Extraction and passage storage come first. AI understanding can later add a document profile alongside the text. A pending or failed profile does not prevent retrieval of passages with ready embeddings.

Topics

Understanding and embedding are tracked separately, because they can fail separately. A document whose profile is still being written is shown as exactly that, rather than as finished.

05
KNOWLEDGE RETRIEVAL
Retrieval is a filter, not a search box.
Semantic search gathers candidates. When available, a reranker scores them against the question and a relevance gate applies the configured threshold. If scoring is unavailable, the run records that fallback rather than implying that every passage passed a relevance score check.
Configured embeddings
Compatible passage and query space
Semantic retrieval
Nearest candidates
Optional reranking
Retrieval order if unavailable
Relevance gate
Applied when scores are available
RETRIEVED
RERANKED
PAST THE GATE
Illustration of the retrieval stages. The quantities shown are chosen to make the narrowing legible — they are not a measurement, and no run is being reported. Real counts for a real question appear on that question’s research run inside the platform.
06
GROUNDED INTELLIGENCE
An answer is only as good as the evidence it was allowed to use.
In the grounded-answer path, the synthesis model receives the selected passages and citation identifiers are checked against that supplied evidence. Other outcomes are labelled separately when evidence cannot support the request.
Question
Evidence
Selected passages, when available
Synthesis
Answer written from evidence
Citation validation
Checked against what was supplied
Grounded answer
Citation identifiers are checked against supplied evidence

Every citation the model returns is matched back to a passage that was actually supplied to it. A citation pointing at something that was never in the evidence is rejected from the accepted citation list. The answer can still disclose unverified markers; identifier validation alone does not verify every claim or plotted value.

Every answer says where it came from

AIKDAP grounds answers in your documents first, searches the web when they fall short, and clearly labels anything answered from general knowledge — that answer never carries a citation it does not have.

07
PROVIDER RESILIENCE
Configured fallback providers can keep research moving.
Synthesis talks to an internal gateway rather than to a vendor. The gateway holds an ordered chain of providers and can try the next configured option when one cannot serve a request. The run records the provider used or reports failure if the chain is exhausted.

PRIMARY

Gemini

FIRST FALLBACK

Groq

SECOND FALLBACK

OpenRouter

Illustrative provider chain. Actual providers and their order depend on configuration. This diagram does not report availability or guarantee that a run succeeds. Current provider health appears on the System Health page.
08
RESEARCH WORKSPACE
The workspace shows its working.
Every run is inspectable after the fact. The stages it executed, the passages that survived each of them, and available citation sources can be inspected alongside the answer. Supporting detail can be expanded when needed.
Pipeline timeline

Every stage of a run, in the order it executed, with what each one produced.

Evidence funnel

How many passages were retrieved, how many reached the model, and how many were cited — for that run.

Citation to source

Open any citation to see the passage behind it, the document it came from, and how it scored.

into intelligence.
